name: bulkhead
description: Guards for a machine where many coding agent sessions run at once: blocks name-based kills of another session's processes, port collisions, git commands that would move or delete another session's tree, whole-disk scans and long foreground sleeps, and holds heavy commands back when RAM runs low.

interface.shortDescription: Guards for many parallel agent sessions on one machine
interface.longDescription: Guards for a machine where many coding agent sessions run at once. Before Codex runs a shell command, bulkhead blocks name-based kills of another session's processes, port collisions, git commands that would move or delete another session's tree, whole-disk scans and long foreground sleeps, and holds heavy commands back when RAM runs low.
